title: RFC005 Candidate Track (§11/§44, plan spec-candidate-track-c4)
$comment: Closed envelope, v1. A CandidateTrack binds one admission track name to one clean_pretrained base ancestry, one component lock and one architecture manifest -- it is a cross-checked derived manifest, never hand-assembled. checkpoint_rights_status/checkpoint_privacy_status, initialization_kind, legacy_ancestry, transitive_exposure_manifest and ancestry_hash are all COPIED verbatim from the underlying checkpoint_ancestry document (unflatten.model.checkpoint_ancestry) AFTER it passes verify_base -- this schema does not and cannot re-derive them; candidate_track.py refuses to build a document whose copied fields disagree with a freshly-verified ancestry. adapter_policy is always the 'registry' shape in v1 (RFC005-ERRATA-001 E1's adapter_plus_new_heads_no_lora); it has no other branch, since no producer or plan decision for one exists yet. base_checkpoint's 'checkpoint' branch exists in-schema for a future checkpoint-anchored track -- v1 only ever produces base_weights_only. transitive_exposure_manifest mirrors checkpoint_ancestry's own exposure_state union but renames the non-not_produced branch to 'hash' (an ancestry 'root' branch's root_hash becomes this document's transitive_exposure_manifest.sha256) because a candidate track exposes only the hash, not the root-object shape.

admission_track_name.$comment: Pinned to the one track name unflatten.dataset.admission.report.DENSE_CONTRACT_CANARY_TRACK / unflatten.model.trainability_smoke.DENSE_CONTRACT_CANARY_TRACK name today (RFC004 ratified only for dense_contract_canary_ready/dense_vertical_slice_ready under DEC-005).

adaptation_kind.$comment: RFC005-ERRATA-001 E1: the one adaptation kind v1 produces -- an adapter plus new heads, no LoRA delta.

base_checkpoint.$comment: Closed union, never a bare array. v1 only ever produces base_weights_only; the checkpoint branch exists in-schema for a future checkpoint-anchored track.

transitive_exposure_manifest.$comment: Closed union, never a bare array -- mapped from checkpoint_ancestry's exposure_state: not_produced copies verbatim, root becomes {kind: hash, sha256: root_hash}.

adapter_policy.$comment: v1 always produces the registry branch (RFC005 §14.3). No other branch exists: adding one requires a producer and a plan decision first.
